# Specrails Desktop — for agents

> When asked to connect to Specrails MCP, read the agent runbook before changing client configuration.

- [Connection runbook: Claude, Codex, Kimi and Gemini](docs/agents/mcp.md)
- [MCP surface and permissions](docs/mcp.md)

The runbooks cover the bridge bundled with Desktop, not the legacy standalone npm hub. Preserve existing servers; verify initialize, tools/list and a read-only project list. Never include tokens in reports.
